Filters (8 dimensions)

TypeRisk / Control / Policy L1Foundational — the control is present and on. Absence is a finding in itself. L2Advanced — the control is tuned, measured and alerting. Assumes L1 and asks whether it works. L3Defense-in-depth — assumes the L1/L2 control here has already been bypassed and bounds the damage anyway: containment, isolation, attenuation, reversibility. Evidence-only measures are L2.
